why: Backing up worked: forward view now shows the FULL gate, both yellow posts and top+bottom cyan crossbars, opening roughly left-of-center in frame (~10-15deg left of heading). The proposed move turns left a further 28.5deg on top of that, which is close to what carried us past this same post last time without transiting - too much rotation risks the same miss. Taking a smaller, more precise correction instead: modest forward+left translation with a small left yaw to square up on the opening's center before committing to a bigger push through it.
